import collections
import text

passage := "The cat sat on the mat. The dog sat on the rug, and the cat watched the dog. A bird sang on the fence, and the Dog barked at the bird. The cat slept in the sun, the bird flew away, and the dog sat by the door."
tokens := text.ascii_words(passage, ignore_case = true)
counts := tokens.frequencies()
for (word, amount) := collections.ranked_entries(counts)[:<5][]
    println("{word}: {amount}")
println("distinct words: {counts.size()}")
